method: Patterns were proposed from the evidence bank with no preset topic list, merged, then tested against the full bank - including all 4,612 Senate roll-call votes - for contradictions and say-do tension, then reviewed for evidence strength.

patterns.name: Iran must not obtain a nuclear weapon
patterns.reader_note: Rubio consistently states that Iran must not obtain a nuclear weapon.

examples.quote: The United States is implementing snapback sanctions against the Iranian regime. | we will deny Iran all paths to a nuclear weapon.

SECRETARY RUBIO: We would prefer the diplomatic route and we’re going to give it every chance to succeed but here’s the bottom line: Iran and the people in charge there can never have a nuclear weapon.
Senator @MarcoRubio, Colleagues Introduce The Nuclear Weapon Free Iran Act
